Dark mode

Issue #459 by @neopolii · PR #486

Tap the moon at the top of any screen, or turn on Settings ▸ Display ▸ Dark mode. The parchment and paper screens step down to warm charcoal, ink text turns cream, and every hue stays put: Hero Red, the aspect colors, the status tags. Card art and card faces are never recolored.

Where the switch is

  • A moon (go dark) or sun (go light) button at the top of every screen. On a phone it's a short tab on the top edge.
  • Settings ▸ Display ▸ Dark mode, also in Pause's Table group. Controllers and keyboards use this row, so the d-pad never lands on the top button by accident.
  • It's saved with your other settings, and starts off.

What it changes

  • Screens, popups, the campaign book's pages and text fields go dark. A selected or hovered control is still the lighter one.
  • The ink chrome stays as it was: top bars, the action bar, the table felt.
  • Text on yellow and other bright grounds stays dark ink, so NOTICE tags and stamps still read.
  • Flipping it mid-game repaints what's on screen. Your board, an open popup or a half-built deck are kept.

Cartas en español

Issue #337 · PR #393

¡Ya puedes jugar con tus cartas en español! Desde esta versión, cada instalador y el APK se publican dos veces: en inglés (-EN-) y en español (-ES-). Las versiones en español muestran la impresión española de cada carta que la tiene: 4.053 de las 4.312 cartas. Las demás se ven en inglés.

Cómo conseguirlo

  • Windows, macOS, Linux y Android: descarga el archivo con -ES- en el nombre, o abre Descargas en español en el README.
  • El instalador en español reemplaza la versión en inglés y conserva tus partidas guardadas.
  • En el navegador: la web incluye los dos idiomas. Empieza en el idioma de tu navegador, y el botón del globo, junto al de la música, lo cambia en cualquier momento. También está en Ajustes ▸ Cartas.
  • En las apps de escritorio y de móvil, el globo explica qué descarga tiene cada idioma.

Gracias

Los escaneos en español son de mc-ocr, de alaintxu, que nos dio permiso para usarlos. ¡Muchas gracias, alaintxu!

Lo pidió ★@AntonioAPG. ¡Gracias por la idea!

¿Encontraste un error? El formulario de reportes ahora pregunta en qué idioma jugabas, y el reporte desde el juego lo rellena solo.

Lo que viene: el texto del juego, el texto de las cartas y las reglas en español (#390, #391 y #392).

Rules audit, part 5

PR #410 by @bluefireF5ran · PR #477

@bluefireF5ran keeps working through RRG 1.8 and FFG's rulings, one fix per commit, each with its source. The biggest change is how responses open: responses to a sentence now wait until the whole sentence resolves, then open as one window where you order them freely.

The new response window

Gamma Blast waits for its damage

Spectrum's Gamma Blast deals its 7 damage before the energy-form response, so a tough enemy blocks it. Photon Speed works the same way. When responses to different conditions share a window, the sheet now says which one they answer, and an optional response offered ahead of the forced ones says Not now: you'll be asked again after the forced ones resolve.

RRG 1.8 p. 45, p. 38, p. 5, p. 20 · FFG ruling Dec 8, 2023 (#126)
Also in this part

Seven more rulings

Drawing up to hand size draws one card at a time, so Shapeshifter Surprise or a drawn obligation resolves before the next card. The villain-phase recap still counts the whole draw.

The Power Of cards no longer double their resources when paying for the Ant-Man or Wasp allies.

Ready for a Fight takes a hero with two hero forms to the other one, and Bodyslide lets them. The log now names the face: "You changed to Giant Wasp."

Frenemies removes both threats at once, so a crisis icon still protects the main scheme.

Wolverine's Claws pierces only the first attack of the played event.

I've Been Waiting For This! as a boost: the villain schemes after the boosted attack and its responses finish.

When one effect activates several enemies, villains go before minions.

RRG 1.8 p. 6, p. 21 · FFG rulings #22, #87, #127, #190, #214 and Aug 14, 2025

You asked, we fixed

Issues #458 · #462 · #478 · #479 · #480 · #496 · PR #503
#479 · reported by @zackburnley

A Trophy Room you can fold

Each category folds and opens with a tap, and they all start folded. A Filters bar sorts by category, completion, points or A–Z, either way, with Expand all and Collapse all. The room remembers which ones you opened.

#478 and #480 · reported by @zackburnley

Phones feel right

A sideways flick keeps coasting after you lift your finger, on the hero and scenario shelves, as the vertical scroll already did.

The back gesture steps back a screen. Android's back gesture, a browser's Back and a mouse's back button now close what's open, or open Pause in a game, instead of closing the app.

The title menu also scrolls on a window too short for it, such as a phone held sideways.

#458 · reported by @neopolii

The deck builder fills a wide screen

On a wide window the card pool adds columns as it grows, and the card hover always enlarges the card, at least 1.5 times its size on screen.

#462 · reported by @andy-xxvii27

Upgraded Drones can be discarded

A card attached to an environment now shows on the environment's tile, so you can use its ability, like spending to discard Upgraded Drones.

#496 · reported by @AlecHolland1582

After Zola, your own Basic upgrade

In The Rise of Red Skull, after beating Zola with Hydra Prison gone, each hero in hero form may flip the Basic upgrade they took after Absorbing Man to its Improved side. The game used to offer every Condition card in the first hero's deck. Now each hero is offered only their own upgrade, one hero at a time, with a Keep it Basic choice.

The same fix gives each hero their own column for Sinister Motives' Planning Ahead reward.

PR #503 · reported by @funguykawhi on Discord

A controller reaches the whole table

On a Steam Deck, LB/RB and the D-pad couldn't reach the villain, the schemes, the minions or attachments, so Y had nothing to inspect there. Now every card on the table is a stop: LB/RB jump to the villain zone, the D-pad moves between the villain, schemes and minions, and Y inspects (hold to zoom).

A on a card with nothing to use opens it in Inspect, as a tap does. On a phone, RB switches to the Enemies or Threat tab and lands there.

Clean new scans

#466 · #468 · #485 · PR #490

More cards now use my own scans: straight, sharp and with no watermark. Captain Marvel's crooked card with a white tab, reported by @neopolii, is gone.

  • Spider-Man and Captain Marvel: core decks and nemesis sets.
  • Black Panther: core deck and nemesis set, plus every core aspect and basic card and the Rise of Red Skull aspect cards.
  • Nebula: all 24 cards of the pack, from Cutthroat Ambition to Defensive Training, and both identity sides.

Also in v0.39.0

Desktop · rules · contributors

Desktop

  • The Windows Install for Steam script is now a .cmd you double-click. No execution policy change needed.
  • A text field, like the Seats search bar, stays in place under a card hover instead of blinking out.
  • Android and Linux preview builds of a merged pull request no longer linger on the Releases page.

Rules, fine print

  • Mysterio's encounter cards are still dealt after the whole hand refill, even when one draw nests in another.
  • When a played event's first attack is cancelled, Wolverine's Claws gives piercing to the next one.
  • A response that can't be used is no longer reported as "not offered" in the middle of a reveal.

For contributors

  • Card art, music and art moved out of git into versioned bundles. pnpm assets:fetch downloads them once per machine, so a checkout is far smaller.
  • Add or replace card scans, music or art from a pull request by putting the files in incoming/. After the merge they're packed into the bundles for you.
  • Release builds clone faster and time out instead of holding up the queue.
